description: This file is a shell script that manages the lifecycle of the mldproxy service, including starting, stopping, and responding to system events such as wan-status and lan-status changes. It configures and runs the mldproxy daemon based on system state.

methods.name: do_start_mldproxy
methods.description: Starts the mldproxy service by creating configuration, killing existing instances, and launching the daemon if available.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service variables by retrieving configuration and system interface names.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the mldproxy service if enabled and conditions are met.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the mldproxy service and cleans up configuration.
